What landscaping crews order

Built for the work

  • Pocket tees and sun-protective long sleeves with your logo on the chest and a big back print
  • Hi-vis and ANSI safety shirts and sweatshirts for road-side work
  • Hoodies, quarter-zips and insulated vests for fall cleanups and plowing
  • Mesh-back trucker caps and beanies for the whole crew

Tips for landscaping & lawn care uniforms

  • Pick a light, breathable tee for summer and a heavier hoodie for spring and fall - most crews order both.
  • A large back print with your company name and phone number turns every shirt into a moving ad.
  • Order a few extra in the most common sizes so new hires are covered mid-season.

Company orders

How crew and company orders work

1

Send your logo & headcount

Tell us the garments, colors and roughly how many people. Email your logo to meadowprintsembroidery@gmail.com - any file works.

2

Get a quote & proof

You get a quote and a digital proof within 24 hours. Volume pricing kicks in automatically on larger orders.

3

Send your size run

Send sizes (and names, if you want them stitched) as a simple list. Mixed sizes and tall sizes are fine.

4

Reorder any time

We keep your logo and order details on file, so restocking for new hires is one call or email.
